title: Opening 10 test spots for my trading journal, the AI coach predicts your mistakes before you make them
author: MT168_B6
selftext:
Built this because of my own ugly month. My journal showed me 7 trades, 0 percent win rate, minus 248 dollars, and 3 entries without a stop loss. I would have sworn it was one. That gap between the trader I thought I was and what my fills actually said is the whole reason the tool exists.

It's called DojiPad and the part I need tested is the coach, DJ. It doesn't just log your trades. Before your session it writes down a prediction about your behavior, stuff like if your first trade loses you'll re-enter the same direction within 15 minutes. Then it scores its own prediction against your real fills. So you're not trusting the coaching, you can check its hit rate on you specifically.

Full disclosure, I'm the founder. Looking for 10 active traders to test it properly:

You get 3 months of the Pro version free, no card, full platform, journal, simulator, replay, the coach.

You trade how you normally trade for a few weeks.

You tell me honestly what the predictions caught and what they missed. If DJ whiffs on you I want to hear that louder than the wins, a wrong prediction is data too.

Reply here with what you trade and I'll sort out spots this week. Not linking anything unless mods say it's fine.
